---
title: Cross Reference Links Showing Titles
number-sections: true
format:
  html: default
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
  pdf:
    keep-tex: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - "<a href=\"#sec-intro\" class=\"quarto-xref\">Introduction <em>basics</em></a>"
          - "<a href=\"#eq-energy\" class=\"quarto-xref\">mass–energy equivalence</a>"
          # equation without a name falls back to a numbered reference
          - "<a href=\"#eq-plain\" class=\"quarto-xref\">Equation&nbsp;2</a>"
          # links with text are left alone
          - "<a href=\"#sec-intro\">the intro</a>"
        - []
    pdf:
      ensureLatexFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - "\\\\hyperref\\[sec-intro\\]\\{Introduction \\\\emph\\{basics\\}\\}"
          - "\\\\hyperref\\[eq-energy\\]\\{mass--energy equivalence\\}"
          - "Equation~\\\\ref\\{eq-plain\\}"
        - []
    typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - "#link\\(<sec-intro>\\)\\[Introduction #emph\\[basics\\]\\]"
          - "#link\\(<eq-energy>\\)\\[mass--energy equivalence\\]"
          - "#ref\\(<eq-plain>, supplement: \\[Equation\\]\\)"
        - []
---

## Introduction *basics* {#sec-intro}

A link with no text to a section or equation shows the section title or the
equation's `name` instead of its number
(<https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/1196>,
<https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/4532>).
An equation without a name falls back to a regular numbered reference.

$$
E = mc^2
$$ {#eq-energy name="mass–energy equivalence"}

$$
a = b
$$ {#eq-plain}

See [](#sec-intro), [](#eq-energy) and [](#eq-plain), or [the intro](#sec-intro).
